svg.title: JDBC Redisson Redis Cache Architecture
svg.desc: JDBC Redisson architecture rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-redisson README, sync/suspend repositories, loader, and writer source files.
svg.text: Redisson RMapCache or RLocalCachedMap wires read-through loaders, optional writers, and JDBC transaction-backed Exposed persistence.

g.text: Exposed JDBC loader and writer path
Use this view to locate Redisson ownership: config selects RMapCache or RLocalCachedMap, with loader-only or loader-plus-writer mode.
Invalidate paths use cacheOnlyMap unless deleteFromDBOnInvalidate explicitly routes removal through the writer-backed map.
